name: Lust Colony
source:
A couple weeks ago Sophie got expelled from university due to her bad grades, due to a stroke of luck she immediately got a job supervising the development of a resort colony. About a week after the interview Sophie was already traveling to her new job. Help Sophie develop this planet from a jungle to a luxury hotel and maybe have some fun with the rest of the crew.​

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2201420/]Steam[/url]]
